verdict.rationale: Sardine's marketing pages describe in-product AI agents that review sanctions screening matches. The agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research and route higher-risk matches to analysts, and they are described as audit-ready with explainable scores. That covers the agent-review core, but a recorded per-match rationale is only implied by 'audit-ready' and 'explainable scores', never documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent records a rationale for each match decision, first-party technical docs rather than marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale
